name: Madison County School System
calendarType: Color-coded district academic calendar with E-Learning, half-day and employee-schedule distinctions
seoTitle: Madison County Schools Calendars | MCSS Alabama
seoDescription: Browse Madison County School System calendars by year, with reviewed MCSS dates, E-Learning days, half-days, breaks, official PDFs and calendar downloads.
districtFact: MCSS uses separate calendar categories for regular student days, E-Learning/Collaboration Days, half-days, staff development, system closures and a scheduled Weather Day. Its annual PDF also distinguishes student breaks from shorter closure periods for several employee groups.

about.title: E-Learning days remain instructional dates
about.content: MCSS gives E-Learning/Collaboration Days their own calendar color. They are different from no-school days and remain part of the student instructional calendar.

about.title: Student and employee break dates are not identical
about.content: The annual calendar separately lists break periods for students, teachers, 212-plus-day employees and 240-day employees. Families should use the student range when deciding whether classes are in session.

about.title: Half-day dismissal times are school-specific
about.content: The district PDF identifies student half-days but does not print one districtwide dismissal time. Families should confirm transportation, after-school care and dismissal details with their school.

about.title: Use the correct Huntsville-area school system
about.content: This resource follows the Madison County School System calendar. Huntsville City Schools and Madison City Schools are separate districts with their own calendars.

calendarNotes: Use the board-approved MCSS Academic Calendar for districtwide dates. E-Learning/Collaboration Days are instructional dates, while staff development, workdays, breaks and school-system closures have different attendance effects. The employee break ranges printed beside the student calendar do not replace the student schedule. School events, exact half-day dismissal times and later changes should be confirmed with MCSS or the assigned school. A MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically.
